data.content: A printable Christmas murder mystery party for 8 players: The Stolen Star of Hollyridge Lodge, a cozy whodunit set on a snowed-in Christmas Eve. Inside: host guide, party timeline and host script, invitations, 8 character sheets, 9 clue cards in 3 rounds, a Detective Notes sheet, a sealed solution page, name tags and 2 awards. 16 pages, print at home.

36 funny, kind Christmas party awards to print for an office, family or friends holiday party. Includes the award list with a line to read aloud for each, nomination sheets and quick ballot cards, a vote tally sheet, a host script, award and fill-in certificates and a hall of fame page. 13 pages, US Letter, also prints on A4.

A printable Christmas party games bundle for one whole party night: 6 games (word scramble, this or that, would you rather, trivia, find the guest who, charades), 12 party awards, a white elephant dice game, a left-right gift story and a gingerbread house contest with judge cards and ribbons. Host timeline and answer keys included. 16 pages, US Letter or A4.

24 no-prep office Christmas party games for coworkers, with a 45-minute run sheet so whoever got handed the staff party can host it. Coworker bingo, holiday trivia, word scramble, guess the coworker, letter lists and more. No props to buy, no drinking, no movie or song knowledge needed. Score sheet and answer keys included. Printable PDF, black and white is fine.

A printable Christmas escape room for adults and teens: The Snowbound Lodge. Eight linked puzzles, each answer opens the next lock, ending at the Gift Vault. For teams of 2 to 20 at an office party, a friends night or game night, about 45 to 60 minutes. Includes host guide, lock sheet, hint cards, team timer and scores, answer key and a certificate. US Letter PDF, print at home.

A printable Christmas escape room for kids and families: one story, the Bell Vault, with two levels (ages 6-9 and 10+) so mixed ages play together. Puzzles include a gift tag code, workshop shelf count, bell maze and snowflake sudoku, plus envelope lock tags, hint cards, an answer key and certificates. About 45 minutes, no phone or internet needed. 17-page PDF, print at home.

A printable Christmas coupon book: 30 written coupons, 10 for a partner, 10 for kids and 10 for family, plus 5 blank coupons to type your own. Type the names in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader, no Canva or account needed. Includes front and back covers for 3 books and a gift envelope. 13-page PDF on US Letter, print, cut and staple.

A printable Christmas charades game with 120 cards in 3 levels: 40 for kids, 40 for family and 40 for adults (office party and grown-up holiday moments). Act it out in 60 seconds or switch to Draw It mode. Includes how-to-play rules, timer rules, a team score sheet for 2 to 4 teams and 12 blank cards. 16-page PDF, print at home and cut.

A printable Christmas morning scavenger hunt that leads kids to their gift. 24 hiding spots, each with two clue cards: short rhymes for early readers (about ages 4 to 7) and riddles for older kids (about 8 to 12). Includes a parent setup sheet and answer key, blank cards to write your own and final gift cards. About ten minutes of setup the night before. 13-page PDF, print at home on US Letter or A4.

A printable Secret Santa kit for a team, class, friend group or family: an organizer page and sign-up sheet, the Secret Santa questionnaire, a gift idea list by budget, 24 name-draw slips, Secret Santa rules, white elephant and dice swap rules, a who-has-who tracker, 12 cut-out gift tags and thank-you notes. 11 pages, US Letter and A4.

Everything to host a Christmas cookie exchange: fill-in invitations (2 per page), a host countdown, a guest sign-up sheet so no two guests bake the same cookie, swap rules and baking math, recipe cards, cookie labels with allergen boxes, Best Cookie ballots, a voting tally with 4 award cards, thank-you cards and take-home box tags. 13-page printable PDF, US Letter.

Six letters from Santa you type in Adobe Reader and print at home: nice list, first Christmas, new big sibling, kindness, a hard year and new home. The bundle also has an official Nice List certificate, Santa's Nice List, a Dear Santa wish list, 4 North Pole envelope labels and 12 From Santa gift tags. 14-page editable PDF for parents and grandparents this Christmas.

24 Days of Christmas Family Activities: a screen-free December countdown with one simple activity a day. 24 activity cards (6 pages) with a talk-about-it question on each, blank cards for your own traditions, a countdown tracker, a plan-ahead supply list (7 of the 24 need nothing at all) and a family memories page. 13 pages, print at home for kids and families.

A Santa Mail Bundle you type in Adobe Reader: 6 letters from Santa (nice list, first Christmas, new big sibling, kindness, a hard year, new home), an Official Nice List certificate, Santa's Nice List, a Dear Santa wish list, 4 North Pole envelope labels and 12 From Santa gift tags. Type the child's name, print at home and deliver on Christmas Eve. 13 pages, instant download.

The Stolen Star of Hollyridge Lodge, a cozy Christmas whodunit for 8 players. Includes a host guide, a party timeline with lines to read aloud (about 1 hour 45 minutes from arrival to reveal), invitations (2 per sheet), 8 character sheets, 9 clue cards in 3 rounds, a Detective Notes sheet, a sealed solution page, 8 name tags and 2 awards. 16 pages, print at home for a Christmas dinner party.

24 no-prep Christmas games for coworkers. A Game Finder page lists every game by group size, time and type. Games 1 to 5 have printable sheets (Coworker Holiday Bingo, Holiday Word Scramble, Holiday Trivia Showdown, Letter Lists, Guess the Coworker); the other 19 need nothing but people. Also a 45-minute run sheet, a team score sheet and answer keys. 15 pages, print at home for a staff or team holiday party.

The Snowbound Lodge, a printable Christmas escape room for adults and teens. Eight linked puzzles: each answer opens the next lock, ending at the gift vault. For teams of 2 to 20, about 45 to 60 minutes. Includes a host guide, lock sheet, hint cards, team timer and score sheet, answer key and a certificate of escape. US Letter PDF, print at home for an office party, friends or game night.

A printable Christmas party bundle: 6 games (word scramble, this or that, would you rather, trivia quiz, find the guest who, charades cards), 12 party awards, a gingerbread house contest with judge's score cards and ribbons, a White Elephant dice game and a left-right gift story. Includes a host timeline. 16 pages, print at home for a family or office party.

24 printable office Christmas party games for coworkers. Includes a 45-minute party plan, a game finder for all 24 games, how-to-play pages, printable game sheets like Holiday Trivia Showdown and Coworker Holiday Bingo, a team score sheet and answer keys. No prep: print and play at the office party or a holiday luncheon.

A printable Christmas party kit with 6 games (word scramble, this or that, would you rather, trivia quiz, find the guest who, charades cards), 12 party awards, a gingerbread house contest with score cards and ribbons, and 2 gift swap games: a White Elephant dice game and a left-right gift story. Includes a host timeline. Print at home for a family or office party.

An editable Christmas coupon book PDF with 30 coupons: 10 for a partner, 10 for kids and 10 for the family, plus 5 blank coupons you type yourself. Includes front and back covers, how to edit, print and assemble, and a fold-up gift envelope. Type the names, print at home and give it as a last-minute stocking stuffer.

24 printable activity cards for a family Christmas countdown, one small activity a day through December. Includes a how-to page, 24 activity cards, blank cards for your own traditions, a countdown tracker to color in, a plan-ahead supply list and a family memories page. Print at home for an advent calendar the kids will look forward to.

A printable Christmas escape room for the whole family. Kids crack 4 clues (gift tag code, workshop shelf count, tangled lights, snowflake sudoku for ages 6-9; harder versions for 10+), then open the Bell Vault. Includes a game master guide, hint cards, answer key and certificates. About 45 minutes, no phone or internet needed.

Everything to host a Christmas cookie swap, printed at home: fill-in invitations, a guest sign-up sheet so no cookie repeats, recipe cards, cookie labels, ballots, awards, thank-you cards and take-home box tags. 13 pages with a step-by-step host guide and baking math for any number of guests.

A printable Christmas murder mystery for 8 players set at Hollyridge Lodge. Inside: host guide, party timeline and host script, invitations, 8 character booklets, 9 clue cards played over 3 rounds, detective notes, the solution, and name tags with awards. Print at home and host a whodunit dinner party for adults and teens.
